name: Petal Velvet Lipstick
description: A soft matte lipstick with a velvety finish, in rosy shades inspired by petals in full bloom.
ingredients: Ricinus Communis Seed Oil, Euphorbia Cerifera Wax, Kaolin, Tocopherol, Parfum

name: Garden Blush Duo
description: Two silky powder blushes in one compact, a warm peach and a fresh pink, to wear alone or blended.
ingredients: Talc, Mica, Magnesium Stearate, Dimethicone, Tocopherol

name: First Bloom Eyeshadow Palette
description: Nine warm spring shades, from soft cream to rosy brown, in matte and satin finishes.
ingredients: Mica, Talc, Boron Nitride, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Tocopherol

name: Dewy Rose Skin Tint
description: A light, hydrating tint that evens out the skin and leaves a fresh, dewy glow.
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Squalane, Titanium Dioxide, Rosa Damascena Flower Water

name: Frosted Petal Lip Gloss
description: A non-sticky gloss with a cool shimmer that catches the light like frost on petals.
ingredients: Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Mica, Silica, Tocopherol, Parfum

name: Ice Bloom Highlighter
description: A pearly pressed highlighter with a cool pink glow for the cheekbones and the brow bone.
ingredients: Mica, Talc, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Dimethicone, Tocopherol

name: Snowdrop Shimmer Eyeshadow
description: A single shimmer eyeshadow in cool lavender and silver tones, easy to blend with a finger.
ingredients: Mica, Boron Nitride, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Dimethicone, Tocopherol

name: Frozen Rose Setting Powder
description: A weightless translucent powder that sets makeup and keeps shine away, with a cool pink tint.
ingredients: Silica, Mica, Zinc Stearate, Dimethicone, Tocopherol

name: Enchanted Berry Lip Stain
description: A long-lasting water-light stain in deep berry shades that fades softly through the day.
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Propanediol, Rubus Idaeus Fruit Extract, Tocopherol

name: Fairy Dust Glitter Liner
description: A fine-tip liquid liner packed with soft glitter, for a sparkling line or a touch on the inner corner.
ingredients: Aqua, Polyurethane-35, Mica, Butylene Glycol, Phenoxyethanol

name: Moonlit Blossom Blush
description: A buildable cream-to-powder blush in plum and mauve shades with a subtle moonlight sheen.
ingredients: Dimethicone, Mica, Silica, Caprylyl Methicone, Tocopherol

name: Midnight Bloom Mascara
description: A lengthening mascara that separates every lash, in classic black and a deep plum.
ingredients: Aqua, Cera Alba, Stearic Acid, Acacia Senegal Gum, Phenoxyethanol
